data.name: Jeevan Climate Solutions
data.description: Jeevan Climate Solutions (also operating as Jeevan Technology) is a U.S. DAC startup founded in 2022 and based in the Bethlehem/Allentown, Pennsylvania area, spun out of research led by Prof. Arup SenGupta at Lehigh University. The company is developing DeCarbonHIX, a copper-coordinated chelating weak-base ion exchange solid sorbent for direct air capture, with an operational laboratory prototype and plans for a pilot plant.
